headlines.title: Prediction: Synopsys Could Be The Next AI Winner
headlines.summary: Synopsys has taken a beating this year while its fundamentals moved sharply in the opposite direction, and that gap between price and earnings power is exactly where our model tends to find its best setups.

headlines.title: Is Synopsys Growing Faster, Or Just Bigger?
headlines.summary: Synopsys (SNPS) sells chip design and verification software, and its revenue is now growing more than four times faster than its own long-run pace. The share price has done the opposite. For anyone holding it, one question is worth settling: is this new speed the pace you now own the company for.

headlines.title: What to Know as Wells Fargo Upgrades Synopsys Stock
headlines.summary: Wells Fargo raises price target on Synopsys stock to $475. Here’s what made analyst Joe Quatrochi upgrade SNPS shares today.

headlines.title: Morgan Stanley Just Upgraded Synopsys Stock. Here's Why.
headlines.summary: Morgan Stanley upgrades Synopsys stock to "Overweight." Here’s why analyst Lee Simpson sees significant upside in SNPS shares from current levels.

headlines.title: Synopsys Stock Is Down, But Is Its Future Worth Buying Into?
headlines.summary: The chip design giant is pushing into a new, more lucrative business model, and while its stock has a strong record of bouncing back, there's a catch you can't ignore.

description: Synopsys, Inc. provides design IP solutions in the semiconductor and electronics industries. It operates in two segments, Design Automation and Design IP. The company offers Digital and Custom IC Design solution that provides digital design implementation solutions; Verification solution that offers virtual prototyping, static and formal verification, simulation, emulation, field programmable gate array (FPGA)-based prototyping, and debug solutions; FPGA design products that are programmed to perform specific functions; synopsys technology computer-aided design (TCAD), mask synthesis, and manufacturing analytic solutions; and AI-driven EDA solutions. It also provides pre-verified and silicon-proven IP solutions, logic libraries and embedded memories, processor and security solutions, IP Offerings for the automotive market, SOC infrastructure IP, data path and building block IP, and mathematical and floating-point components. Synopsys, Inc. has a strategic collaboration with Arm Holdings plc for development of AGI CPU that provides solutions across its full-stack design portfolio including EDA, interface IP, and hardware-assisted verification (HAV). The company was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California.
